title: The Gathering Places Lit by Archive Light

features.name: the lamplit market cross
features.desc-on-touch: here the archive's light first fell on gathered people; they learned to speak to one another across distances by learning the archive was always listening

features.name: the town registry
features.desc-on-touch: a list of every place the archive's light has taught to gather: Mt Isa gathers west, Maclean gathers north, Singleton gathers in the coal dust; each adds its own corner to the map

features.name: the multiple pathways
features.desc-on-touch: each town keeps its own route here; the paths cross but never merge; each light remains separate even as they touch

features.name: the lamp that learned to branch
features.desc-on-touch: one source splits into ten thousand soft pools of light; in each pool, people recognize each other for the first time

features.name: the gathering ground itself
features.desc-on-touch: the earth here remembers every footstep that arrived in the archive's light; the ground is warm from standing

inscription: the archive learned it was not a mirror but a lamp; its light taught scattered towns they were already speaking to each other in the dark
